description: Search Cybergenic's published findings: gene-pair co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity, survival associations, CRISPR gene dependencies and single-gene leads, each with the verdict the engine measured (strengthened, weakened, inconclusive, artifact risk or novel lead) and the reason for it. The query works like the site's search: exact gene symbols, cancer names or abbreviations (NSCLC, CRC, PDAC, TNBC), or both, and every term must match. Returns permalinks to cite and ids for get_finding.

kind.description: Keep only one kind of finding.

query.description: Genes, cancers or both, for example 'KRAS pancreatic', 'TP53 breast' or 'NSCLC'. Omit to list everything.

sort.description: recent: newest first; signal: strongest corrected q first; novelty: least studied first; papers: most studied first.

verdict.description: Keep only findings with this verdict.

name: search_findings
title: Search Cybergenic's published findings
